parsed.use_case: A monitoring service can report the current value at a chosen rank, such as the third-highest response time, as new measurements arrive. It must update the result after each measurement without retaining or reordering the entire history.
system_examples: Streaming observability dashboard — reports the kth-highest latency or resource measurement as new samples arrive.
Online leaderboard service — tracks the kth-highest score as players submit new results.
parsed.explanation: A min-heap limited to k values keeps the largest k observations, with the smallest of those at its root as the answer. Each insertion takes O(log k), versus sorting all n observations after every update at O(n log n); this keeps updates efficient when streams are long, though these ranked summaries are most useful when the requested rank is small.
